title: Verb + to-infinitive or -ing?
summary: Глаголы, после которых возможны и to-infinitive, и -ing: remember, forget, regret, stop, try, go on, mean, need, like / love / hate, allow / advise / recommend, а также used to и be used to; различие в значении и оттенках.
ru:
## Глаголы, у которых меняется значение
После некоторых глаголов можно употребить и **to-infinitive**, и **-ing**, но смысл разный. Общее правило: **-ing** обычно относится к тому, что **уже происходило или происходит**, **to-infinitive** — к тому, что **ещё предстоит** или является целью.
- **remember / forget**: **to do** — вспомнить / забыть о долге, плане: *Remember **to lock** the door.* (не забудь запереть). **doing** — вспомнить / забыть о событии в прошлом: *I remember **locking** the door* (помню, что запирал); *I'll never forget **seeing** the Northern Lights.*
- **regret**: **to say / tell / inform** — с сожалением сообщать (формально): *We regret **to inform** you that…* **doing** — жалеть о прошлом: *I regret **not studying** harder.*
- **stop**: **to do** — остановиться, чтобы сделать (цель): *She stopped **to buy** a newspaper.* **doing** — прекратить: *He stopped **smoking** ten years ago.*
- **try**: **to do** — стараться, прикладывать усилие (может не получиться): *I tried **to open** the window, but it was jammed.* **doing** — попробовать как эксперимент: *Try **taking** an aspirin.*
- **go on**: **doing** — продолжать то же самое: *She went on **talking** for hours.* **to do** — перейти к следующему действию: *After the budget she went on **to prepare** the schedule.*
- **mean**: **to do** — намереваться: *I didn't mean **to hurt** you.* **doing** — означать, влечь за собой: *This job means **working** at weekends.*
- **need**: **to do** — нужно делать: *I need **to leave**.* **need doing** — пассивное значение: *The software needs **updating*** (= to be updated).

## Почти без разницы в значении
После **begin, start, continue, intend, like, love, hate, prefer** оба варианта допустимы: *It started **to rain** / **raining**.* Но если сам глагол стоит в **-ing**, второй -ing избегают: *It was starting **to rain**.* (~~It was starting raining.~~)
**like / love / hate / prefer**: форма **-ing** — «получать удовольствие от процесса»: *I like **swimming**.* **to-infinitive** — «считать правильным / привычно поступать»: *I like **to visit** the dentist twice a year.* После **would like / would love / would hate / would prefer** — только **to**: *I'd hate **to miss** it.*

## Глагол + дополнение: allow, advise, recommend, permit
С прямым дополнением — **to-infinitive**, без дополнения — **-ing**:
> They don't allow **smoking** here. / They don't allow **guests to smoke** here.
> I'd advise **taking** a taxi. / I'd advise **you to take** a taxi.
> We recommend **booking** early. (с you — предпочитают that-clause: *We recommend that you book early.*)

## used to, be used to, get used to
- **used to + V** — прошлая привычка (сейчас нет): *We used **to spend** every summer at my grandparents'.*
- **be / get used to + -ing** — привык / привыкаю: *I'm not used **to driving** on the left.* Здесь **to — предлог**, поэтому после него -ing или существительное.
То же самое с **look forward to, object to, in addition to, be committed to**: *I look forward to **seeing** you.* ~~I look forward to see you.~~

## Прилагательные: afraid to и afraid of
- **afraid to do** — боюсь делать, потому что это опасно/неприятно: *I'm afraid **to jump**.*
- **afraid of doing** — боюсь, что случится: *I'm afraid **of falling**.*
- Другие пары: *sorry to hear* (реакция на новость) / *sorry for being late* (извинение).

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I remember to meet her last year.~~ → I remember **meeting** her last year.
- ~~Don't forget buying milk.~~ → Don't forget **to buy** milk.
- ~~He stopped to smoke, so he is healthier.~~ → He stopped **smoking**.
- ~~I'm used to get up early.~~ → I'm used to **getting** up early.
- ~~I can't help to laugh.~~ → I can't help **laughing**.
en:
## Verbs where the meaning changes
After some verbs both **to-infinitive** and **-ing** are possible, but the meaning is different. As a rule, **-ing** refers to something that **already happened or is happening**; **to-infinitive** refers to something **still to come** or to a purpose.
- **remember / forget**: **to do** = the duty or plan: *Remember **to lock** the door.* **doing** = a memory of the past: *I remember **locking** the door.*
- **regret**: **to say / tell / inform** = sorry to announce (formal): *We regret **to inform** you…* **doing** = feel sorry about the past: *I regret **not studying** harder.*
- **stop**: **to do** = stop in order to do something: *She stopped **to buy** a newspaper.* **doing** = quit: *He stopped **smoking**.*
- **try**: **to do** = make an effort: *I tried **to open** the window.* **doing** = test something: *Try **taking** an aspirin.*
- **go on**: **doing** = continue: *She went on **talking**.* **to do** = move on to the next thing: *She went on **to prepare** the schedule.*
- **mean**: **to do** = intend: *I didn't mean **to hurt** you.* **doing** = involve: *This job means **working** at weekends.*
- **need**: **to do** = it is necessary for me: *I need **to leave**.* **need doing** = passive meaning: *The software needs **updating**.*

## Little difference
After **begin, start, continue, intend, like, love, hate, prefer** both forms are possible: *It started **to rain** / **raining**.* But if the verb itself is in the -ing form, we avoid a second -ing: *It was starting **to rain**.*
**like / love / hate / prefer**: **-ing** = enjoyment of the activity (*I like **swimming***); **to** = habit or a sensible choice (*I like **to visit** the dentist twice a year*). After **would like / would hate** only **to**: *I'd hate **to miss** it.*

## allow, advise, recommend, permit
With an object: **to-infinitive**. Without an object: **-ing**.
> They don't allow **smoking** here. / They don't allow **guests to smoke**.
> I'd advise **taking** a taxi. / I'd advise **you to take** a taxi.

## used to, be used to, get used to
- **used to + V**: a past habit: *We used **to spend** every summer there.*
- **be / get used to + -ing**: accustomed: *I'm not used **to driving** on the left.* Here **to** is a preposition.
Also **look forward to, object to, in addition to**: I look forward to **seeing** you.

## afraid to and afraid of
**afraid to do** = unwilling because it is dangerous: *I'm afraid **to jump**.* **afraid of doing** = fear of what may happen: *I'm afraid **of falling**.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~I remember to meet her last year.~~ → I remember **meeting** her.
- ~~Don't forget buying milk.~~ → Don't forget **to buy** milk.
- ~~I'm used to get up early.~~ → I'm used to **getting** up early.
- ~~I can't help to laugh.~~ → I can't help **laughing**.
structure:
## Изменение значения
| Глагол | + to-infinitive | + -ing |
|---|---|---|
| remember | помнить о долге: Remember to call. | помнить о событии: I remember calling. |
| forget | забыть сделать: I forgot to call. | забыть, что было: I'll never forget seeing it. |
| regret | сообщать с сожалением: regret to inform | жалеть о прошлом: regret leaving |
| stop | остановиться ради: stopped to rest | прекратить: stopped smoking |
| try | стараться: tried to open | пробовать: try taking |
| go on | перейти к следующему: went on to say | продолжать: went on talking |
| mean | намереваться: meant to help | влечь: means waiting |
| need | need to do | need doing = to be done |

## С дополнением и без
| Без объекта | С объектом |
|---|---|
| allow / permit + -ing | allow / permit sb + to V |
| advise / recommend + -ing | advise / recommend sb + to V |
| forbid + -ing | forbid sb + to V |

## used to / be used to
| Форма | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| used to + V | давняя привычка в прошлом | I used to smoke. |
| be used to + -ing | привык | I'm used to working nights. |
| get used to + -ing | привыкаю | I'm getting used to it. |

## Формулы
> would like / love / hate / prefer + **to V**
> like / love / hate / prefer + **-ing** (удовольствие) или + **to V** (привычка)
> **be afraid to** do (боюсь делать) · **be afraid of** doing (боюсь, что случится)

exercises.title: to-infinitive или -ing?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в нужную форму (to do или doing).
exercises.example: He stopped (smoke) ten years ago. → He stopped **smoking** ten years ago.

items.text: I remember {{locking}} the door, so the key must be inside.
Remember {{to lock}} the door when you leave.
She stopped {{to buy}} a newspaper on her way to work.
We regret {{to inform}} you that the flight has been cancelled.
I regret {{not studying|not having studied}} harder at school.
After finishing the budget, she went on {{to prepare}} the schedule.
I tried {{to open}} the window, but it was jammed.

exercises.title: try, mean, used to, can't help
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в нужную форму.

items.text: If you have a headache, try {{taking}} an aspirin.
I didn't mean {{to hurt}} your feelings.
I'm not used to {{driving}} on the left.
We used {{to spend}} every summer at my grandparents'.
I can't help {{laughing}} when I see his hat.
I look forward to {{seeing}} you next week.

items.q: Don't forget ___ milk on your way home.
I'll never forget ___ the Northern Lights for the first time.
Mark stopped ___ at the petrol station.
She went on ___ about her trip for hours.
items.why: Продолжала то же самое → **go on doing**.

items.q: I tried ___ the file, but the computer froze.
items.why: Усилие, которое не удалось → **try to do**.

items.q: This new schedule means ___ at 6 a.m. every day.
The hotel doesn't allow ___ in the rooms.
The hotel doesn't allow guests ___ in the rooms.
She is afraid of ___ lost in the forest.
It was starting ___ when we left the café.
items.why: Если сам глагол в **-ing**, второй -ing не ставят: **starting to rain**.

exercises.title: Перефразируйте
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово в скобках.

items.prompt: He paused. He wanted to check his phone. (stop) → He ...
answers: He stopped to check his phone.

items.prompt: I remember that I met her at a conference in 2015. (remember) → I ...
answers: I remember meeting her at a conference in 2015.

items.prompt: I'm sorry that I have to tell you that your application was rejected. (regret) → I ...
answers: I regret to tell you that your application was rejected.
I regret to inform you that your application was rejected.

items.prompt: Taking the job will involve moving abroad. (mean) → Taking the job ...
answers: Taking the job will mean moving abroad.

items.prompt: He was a smoker before, but now he isn't. (used to) → He ...
answers: He used to smoke.

items.prompt: I experimented with taking cold showers every morning. (try) → I ...
answers: I tried taking cold showers every morning.
I tried taking a cold shower every morning.

items.prompt: Я не забыл позвонить ему. (forget / call)
answers: I didn't forget to call him.
I did not forget to call him.
I haven't forgotten to call him.
I've not forgotten to call him.
I have not forgotten to call him.
Stop making noise!
Stop making a noise!
Stop making that noise!
Stop making noise.
Stop making a noise.
Stop making that noise.
He was afraid to jump.
He was afraid of jumping.

items.prompt: Я привыкла вставать рано. (be used to / get up early)
answers: I'm used to getting up early.
I am used to getting up early.
I've got used to getting up early.
I have got used to getting up early.
I've gotten used to getting up early.
I have gotten used to getting up early.
I got used to getting up early.

items.prompt: Попробуйте перезагрузить роутер. (try / restart the router)
answers: Try restarting the router.
Try to restart the router.

items.prompt: Мы продолжили работать после обеда. (go on / work / after lunch)
answers: We went on working after lunch.
We carried on working after lunch.
We continued working after lunch.
We continued to work after lunch.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя конструкции юнита.

items.prompt: Что вы помните из раннего детства? (I remember ...ing)
items.sample: I remember playing in the snow with my brother.

items.prompt: О чём вы часто забываете? (I often forget to ...)
items.sample: I often forget to charge my phone at night.
I stopped eating sweets last year.

items.prompt: Чего вы боитесь или не боитесь? (afraid of / afraid to)
items.sample: I'm not afraid to speak English, but I'm afraid of making mistakes.

items.prompt: К чему вы недавно привыкли? (get used to)
items.sample: I've got used to getting up at six every day.

items.prompt: Что вы с удовольствием делаете и что вам бы не хотелось пропустить? (I like ...ing / I'd hate to ...)
items.sample: I like walking in the park, and I'd hate to miss the final of the tournament.
